responsibility: Declares the side-effect range inference support for the ranger subsystem. It defines gimple_infer_range, which extracts inferred operand constraints such as nonzero/nonnull facts from a single statement, and infer_range_manager, which stores and queries these inferred ranges on basic-block exits, optionally populating them on demand via immediate-use scans.
same_name_distinction: Declares the side-effect inference interfaces gimple_infer_range and infer_range_manager that gcc/gimple-range-infer.cc fills in. Unlike the .cc file, it specifies how inferred ranges are represented and queried, not how statements are analyzed to discover or record those facts.
